about_the_game:
Stu the fisherman is a fishing rogue-lite experience like no other.

Buy mysterious items from a hooded figure that enhance the value of your haul, help to fix the town and discover the mysteries of the sky fish, the sea fish and the people who just might know it all.

  • Catch dozens of varieties of sea creatures

  • Purchase dozens of trinkets to enhance your hauls.

  • Fix a town in shambles and help the residents.

  • Unwrap the mysteries of ancient beasts of the sea, sky and Stu.
